market_view.rationale: A narrow gain in top-heavy Nifty 50 masks severe underlying weakness, as small-cap and mid-cap indices dropped sharply alongside a dismal advance-decline ratio where under 17% of stocks remain above their 50-day moving average. With INDIA VIX staying elevated at the 70th percentile and FIIs resuming net selling in the latest session, conditions remain hostile for long swing trades in the broader market.

sector_pick.name: NIFTY IT
sector_pick.rationale: NIFTY IT remains the primary structural safe haven, showcasing elite relative strength with a 17.84% one-month gain despite broad market liquidations.

last_week_review: Last week's bearish market call and NIFTY IT sector pick held up exceptionally well as mid- and small-caps continued to bleed while IT extended its major relative leadership.
